### Law_SortedIndicesIsStable

[stdlib/tests/sorting.laws.plato, line 27](../../../../../stdlib/tests/sorting.laws.plato#L27)

```plato
// Stability: when two elements compare equal, their source order survives.
// Keys are folded into a handful of buckets so the pseudorandom input
// actually produces ties for the law to bite on.
Law_SortedIndicesIsStable(xs: Array<Integer>): Boolean
{
    var keys = xs.Map(x => x % 4);
    var perm = keys.SortedIndices((a, b) => a <= b);
    return (perm.Count - 1).Greater(0).MapRange(i =>
        keys[perm[i]] != keys[perm[i + 1]] || perm[i] < perm[i + 1]).All(b => b);
}
```

```plato
    //==
    // # The derived array surface
    //
    // Reference bodies for everything that used to be an Array / Array2D / Array3D
    // host intrinsic (plato-378). The kernel left in `intrinsics.library.plato` is
    // four functions — `Count`, `At`, `MapRange`, `Reduce` — plus `FlatMap`;
    // everything here is a reindexing of `MapRange` or a fold over `Reduce`.
    //
    // These define the SEMANTICS. A backend that has a faster native form
    // (Ara3D.Collections.Slice, std::span, a GLSL swizzle) substitutes it through
    // its override table (plato-368) rather than by re-adding an intrinsic. Without
    // that table every derived view below costs a closure per element on C#, so the
    // override table is a prerequisite for adopting this file in a hot path, not an
    // optimization on top of it.
    //
    // Bodies beside a declaration file, per LIBRARIES.md ground rule 1: the sibling
    // declarations are `primitives.plato` (Array) and
    // `primitives.types.plato` (Array2D / Array3D).

    //==
    // # Array — mapping

    // A new Array holding f applied to each element in index order.
    // (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Map_(higher-order_function))
    Map(xs: Array<$T1>, f: Function1<$T1, $T2>): Array<$T2>
        => MapRange(xs.Count, i => f(xs[i]));
```

### Line 266

**Source:** [stdlib/foundation/primitives.library.plato, line 266](../../../../../stdlib/foundation/primitives.library.plato#L266).

```plato

    // A grid of the same shape holding f applied to every cell.
    Map(xs: Array2D<$T1>, f: Function1<$T1, $T2>): Array2D<$T2>
    {
        var elements = xs.Elements.Map(f);
        return (elements, xs.ColumnCount, xs.RowCount);
    }
```
